message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 今天练腿吗 你躲了三天了

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 练 但今天只蹲60 不碰100

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 算你有数 腰是自己的

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 一会儿你深蹲我给你拍 有个膝盖内扣我早想说

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 拍 拍完我看看有多丑

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 不看不知道 一看练腿日变恐吓现场

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 补剂吃了吗 蛋白 今天练后餐吃啥

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 老三样 鸡胸西蓝花米饭 你那杯蛋白粉别又糊弄成奶茶

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 那是好喝的蛋白 你不懂

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 看了你昨天的视频 说真的 你膝盖内扣比我想的严重 来找我科室看看?

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 约 挂你的号有折扣吗

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我们科不打折 但我请你喝蛋白奶昔

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 周四下午三点你行吗 我帮你约张医生

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 练腿日改到周四 练完直接来 别又躲

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 张医生说什么了 我不在场你老实交代

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 轻微代偿 没伤 让我减重加拉伸

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 早说了吧 下周开始 蹲80给我看
